default.summary: EU customer data hosted on US-owned cloud infrastructure stays reachable under the US CLOUD Act regardless of region (e.g. AWS eu-central-1), so DPF/SCC paperwork alone doesn't close the exposure — customer-held encryption keys outside the provider's control are the supplementary measure regulators expect post-Schrems II.
